name: EPIC 211842171

text.card: A red giant 6,238 parsecs away, 13 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 5, give 1.33 solar masses and 13.5 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,936 K at its surface.
